title: NATS Per-Service Identity + ACL Registry
description: Single source of truth for NATS per-service authentication. Validates infrastructure/nats/services.yaml. Consumed by the CI invariant test nats-invariants.spec.ts.

version.description: Schema version. Bump only on breaking shape changes; add migration notes in ADR-015.

services.description: Ordered list of NATS services. Order is preserved by the nats.conf generator for auditable diffs.

name.description: NATS user identifier. MUST exactly match the mTLS client cert CN for this service (verify_and_map maps CN → user). Lowercase snake_case.

application.description: Unique apps/<directory> runtime that owns this certificate identity. APP_TO_SERVICE and deploy invariants derive from this field; identities may not be shared.

description.description: One-line summary of what this service publishes/consumes. Appears in ADR and runbook generation.

publish.description: Subjects this service is permitted to publish to. Must include $JS.API.> for JetStream. NO inbox grant belongs here: responders reply through the broker's allow_responses permission (ORPHAN-CRITICAL-402), which the generator emits for every user.

subscribe.description: Subjects this service is permitted to subscribe to. Must include $JS.API.> for JetStream and _INBOX_<name>.> — this identity's OWN reply inbox (ORPHAN-CRITICAL-402). The shared _INBOX.> is structurally rejected below.

subject.description: NATS subject pattern in a canonical platform namespace. The legacy AQUACULTURE_EVENTS. prefix is structurally rejected because it is a stream name, never a publish subject. The shared `_INBOX.` prefix is ALSO structurally rejected (ORPHAN-CRITICAL-402): every identity's reply inbox is its own first token, `_INBOX_<name>.`, so no certificate can subscribe another's request-reply responses. Secret-bearing exchanges narrow further onto their own first token — `_INBOXBILLINGCFG.` (billing_service ↔ config_service) and `_INBOXFARMMARINECFG.` (farm_service ↔ config_service).
